transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. How can I help you today?

Um… yeah, thanks. I guess the main thing is my eating’s been off. I don’t want to make it sound dramatic, but I barely feel like eating anymore. Like, I’ll be on my lunch break at the store, looking at food I used to actually like, and I just… can’t really get myself to eat it. I end up throwing most of it away. That’s kind of what made me think I should come in, if that makes sense.
Have you noticed yourself feeling down or losing interest in things you used to enjoy, like eating your favorite foods?

Yeah… I mean, I guess I have noticed that. Not in a huge dramatic way, but… stuff I used to actually look forward to just doesn’t really hit anymore. Like gallery nights, playing basketball, getting tacos from the food trucks, even helping kids with art stuff — I used to be into all that. Lately I kind of just stand there feeling flat, and then I’ll make some excuse to leave early. I don’t know if that’s the kind of thing you mean.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for at least the past couple of weeks?

I’m… not totally sure I’d say depressed most of the day every day. I mean, I’ve been more flat and kind of low, yeah, but I don’t want to overstate it if that’s not accurate. Some days I can get through work and seem okay, I think. So… maybe some, but I don’t know if it’s nearly every day like that.
Over the past few weeks, have you had days where you feel down or low for most of the day, not just off and on?

I’m not sure, honestly. I don’t want to say yes if it’s supposed to be really most of the day. There are definitely days where I feel kind of low or weighed down for a while, but I haven’t been tracking it closely. Maybe it comes and goes more than I realize… does that make sense?
Over the past two weeks, how many days would you say you felt low or down for most of the day?

Um… I don’t know if I can give you a solid number. Maybe a few days? I’m trying not to make it sound worse than it is. There have been some days where I felt low for a big chunk of the day, but I didn’t really keep count. Is “a few” an okay answer?
Would you say that on those days when you felt low, the feeling lasted for most of the day, and has this been happening for at least two weeks?

Yeah… I think so. Not every day, but on the days it hits, it can kind of sit there for most of the day. And it’s definitely been more than two weeks — probably closer to, like, two months now, since that window display award and all the attention from the district manager. I didn’t really think of it that way until you asked.
